papers.title: Fatigue properties of Ti-6Al-4V processed by laser metal deposition
papers.abstract: Additive manufacturing is a manufacturing technology that can rapidly form complex structural parts, which can meet the needs of weight reduction and cost reduction in the aerospace field. In the aerospace field, additive manufacturing has gained great attention and is now widely used. Laser Metal Deposition (LMD) additive manufacturing technology is suitable for manufacturing large-size structural components, which is more suitable for manufacturing the main load-bearing parts in aerospace structures. This paper focuses on the fatigue test of three specimen-grade Ti-6Al-4V, to obtain the fatigue performance of LMD Ti-6Al-4V additive manufacturing. The fatigue performance of the LMD Ti-6Al-4V specimens fabricated along the laser scanning direction is superior to that of the conventionally fabricated specimens, as indicated by the results.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了激光金属沉积Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳性能，与用户关注的增材制造Ti-6Al-4V力学和疲劳特性完全匹配。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not include computational modeling or microstructure analysis; it is purely experimental fatigue testing of LMD Ti-6Al-4V, which is well within the L1 scope.

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the fatigue properties of Ti-6Al-4V produced by laser metal deposition additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: Fatigue tests were conducted on LMD Ti-6Al-4V specimens fabricated along the laser scanning direction.
summary_en.result: The fatigue performance of LMD Ti-6Al-4V specimens was found to be superior to that of conventionally fabricated specimens.
